limitations: the MDS is computed from the median sample length and median return shape at each resolution, not per row; individual rows differ by a few percent
power assumes the observed Sharpe is approximately normal around the true one, which is the approximation the DSR itself is built on

the programme charge re-prices trials and dispersion but still cannot charge the choice of assets, resolutions or when each method change was made; it is a floor on the programme's multiplicity, not a complete account
Z_FLOOR = 1.644854 is quoted only for the closed-form reading; the MDS is solved numerically from the DSR

method.inputs_read: the five tranche records only; no panel, no holdout slice
method.minimum_detectable_sharpe: the true annualised Sharpe at which this design's Deflated Sharpe Ratio reaches the 0.95 floor, solved by root-finding on the same compute_deflated_sharpe_ratio the records use
method.power: P(the record would report a pass) when the true Sharpe is s, taking the observed Sharpe as N(s, se(s)) with the DSR's own standard error

programme.note: every row of every tranche re-priced against the programme's whole trial count, held at the dispersion that row's tranche used, so the number moved is the multiplicity the tranche structure hid and not a change of estimator; the pooled-dispersion variant is carried beside it per row as a sensitivity, because pooling can move a hurdle either way

reading: a row that fails the floor is evidence against an effect larger than its minimum detectable Sharpe, and no evidence at all about an effect smaller than it; the headline block carries both numbers so a null cannot be quoted without the threshold it was actually tested at
